title: Advanced Paste: Foundry Local provider shows no models – empty Service URL with Foundry Local 0.10.x

judgment.rationale: The public log and current code identify a concrete endpoint-discovery mismatch with a plausible compatibility fix; one SDK-value trace remains useful before implementation.
evidence: Foundry Local 0.10.3.0 and a loaded phi-4-mini model are supplied.
PowerToys logs an empty Service URL and invalid absolute-URI errors.
Current code exposes Endpoint and ServiceUri through separate accessors.
The report distinguishes this from the older 0.8.x fixed-port issue.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the endpoint trace and approve the endpoint-unification design.

fix_assessment.rationale: FoundryClient reads Endpoint for the service URL while the provider uses ServiceUri for the OpenAI client; with Foundry Local 0.10.x the endpoint property can be empty or incompatible, causing relative URI failures and an empty model list.

proposed_fixes.title: Validate Foundry Local endpoint discovery for 0.10.x
proposed_fixes.root_cause: FoundryClient reads Endpoint for the service URL while the provider uses ServiceUri for the OpenAI client; with Foundry Local 0.10.x the endpoint property can be empty or incompatible, causing relative URI failures and an empty model list.
plan: Centralize endpoint acquisition and validate an absolute base URI.
Use one validated endpoint for model enumeration and OpenAI client creation.
Report unavailable endpoint state instead of advertising availability with zero models.
verification: Run Foundry Local 0.10.3.0 with phi-4-mini loaded and confirm cached models appear.
Retest a supported pre-0.10 Foundry Local installation.

confidence.rationale: The issue log directly shows an empty Service URL and invalid URI errors, and current code reads Endpoint and ServiceUri through separate paths; the exact SDK 0.10.x contract still needs confirmation.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste reports no Foundry Local models even though Foundry Local 0.10.3.0 starts, loads phi-4-mini, and responds in its CLI.
known_information: PowerToys 0.101.2362.0 and Foundry Local 0.10.3.0 are specified.
The issue includes exact invalid-absolute-URI errors and an empty Service URL.
Current FoundryClient exposes Endpoint and ServiceUri separately.
FoundryLocalModelProvider initializes, lists catalog/cached models, and creates an OpenAI client from service data.
The reporter distinguishes this from older issue #45340/#45362 behavior.
inferences: The 0.10.x SDK/daemon contract may no longer populate the property PowerToys currently reads.
IsAvailable may be true because client creation succeeds even though endpoint-based requests cannot run.
issue_context.analysis: The code and logs support a focused endpoint compatibility fix; a fresh manager-property trace would confirm the exact API mapping before implementation.
initial_investigation: FoundryClient.TryCreateClientAsync starts or reuses the SDK manager.
FoundryClient.GetServiceUrl returns Endpoint, while GetServiceUri returns ServiceUri.
FoundryLocalModelProvider.InitializeAsync logs Service URL and calls ListCatalogModels.
GetModelsAsync calls ListCachedModels even when endpoint-dependent calls have failed.
Search found the prior 0.8.x issue/fix referenced by the reporter; the current report targets 0.10.x.

information_gaps.information: The values and absolute/relative forms of FoundryLocalManager.Endpoint and ServiceUri under SDK 0.10.3.0.
information_gaps.why_needed: Confirms which SDK property should be the single base URI and whether a /v1 suffix is required.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Capture the Advanced Paste FoundryLocal log immediately after starting the 0.10.3.0 server; include the existing Log attachment or a fresh `/bugreport` if the log is not sufficient.

actions.label: Request Foundry Local endpoint trace
actions.note: Ask for the one missing SDK compatibility fact.

comment.body: The report already supplies the important reproduction: Foundry Local 0.10.3.0 starts, `phi-4-mini` loads, and PowerToys logs an empty Service URL followed by invalid absolute-URI errors. The remaining decision is whether 0.10.x exposes the usable base address through `Endpoint`, `ServiceUri`, or a different SDK API. Please capture the Advanced Paste log immediately after starting the server and opening the provider page (or submit `/bugreport` immediately after reproducing) so the manager’s discovered endpoint values and SDK errors are visible; this avoids changing the provider against the wrong 0.10.x contract.

actions.label: Design fix: unify Foundry Local endpoint handling
actions.note: Approve a fork-side compatibility design for the 0.10.x endpoint contract.
actions.design_prompt: Unify Foundry Local endpoint discovery, validate the base URI, and preserve supported legacy behavior while fixing 0.10.x model enumeration.

design.root_cause: FoundryClient reads Endpoint for the service URL while the provider uses ServiceUri for the OpenAI client; with Foundry Local 0.10.x the endpoint property can be empty or incompatible, causing relative URI failures and an empty model list.
evidence: The provider logs an empty Service URL before model-list calls fail with invalid URI errors.
The reporter confirms Foundry Local CLI operation independently of PowerToys.

affected_files.purpose: Wraps SDK manager startup, endpoint access, and model enumeration.
Initializes the provider and creates model lists/OpenAI clients.
Loads provider availability and model configuration in Settings.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Two accessors expose different SDK properties and callers use them inconsistently.
implementation_steps.change: Add one validated endpoint result that selects the supported SDK property and rejects empty/non-absolute values with a diagnostic.
implementation_steps.code_block: var endpoint = ResolveBaseUri(_foundryManager); if (endpoint is null || !endpoint.IsAbsoluteUri) throw new FoundryEndpointException(...);
edge_cases: Support legacy and 0.10.x SDK shapes explicitly.
Do not log credentials or local sensitive data.
tests: Test valid legacy, valid 0.10.x, empty, and malformed endpoint values.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Initialization can report a client as available while endpoint-dependent model calls fail.
implementation_steps.change: Use the validated endpoint consistently and make availability reflect usable model discovery/client state.
implementation_steps.code_block: await _foundryClient.InitializeEndpoint(); if (!endpointValid) return unavailable; var models = await _foundryClient.ListCachedModels();
edge_cases: Keep model loading errors distinct from endpoint discovery errors.
tests: Verify model list and chat-client endpoint use the same base URI.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Settings displays no models after provider calls return an empty list.
implementation_steps.change: Show a clear unavailable diagnostic when endpoint discovery fails instead of presenting a misleading empty catalog.
edge_cases: Do not block other Advanced Paste providers.
tests: Run the Settings page against running and unavailable Foundry Local.

verify: Build the common language-model provider and Advanced Paste projects.
Run Foundry Local 0.10.3.0 with phi-4-mini and verify cached model discovery/chat creation.
Retest a supported pre-0.10 installation and malformed endpoint handling.
risks: SDK API compatibility may require a package-version change.
Incorrect /v1 normalization could break chat requests.
Availability UI changes must not hide unrelated provider errors.
alternatives: Hard-coding a fixed port is rejected because the report targets a changed 0.10.x architecture.
Using Endpoint for one caller and ServiceUri for another is rejected because it caused the current inconsistency.
